## The heuristic

**Define the profile from accounts that were won AND kept, never from accounts that were won.
**


_Why:_ Win-rate feedback arrives in weeks and retention feedback arrives in years, so the fast loop is the wrong loop. A segment that closes quickly and churns early inflates every leading indicator on the dashboard and surfaces as a hole in next year's number, by which point the profile has been reinforcing it for four quarters.
